::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Northwest China's first silicon-photonics pilot line, activated 4 November 2025 (cumulative platform investment ~¥1.5 billion) and selected into MIIT's first national manufacturing-pilot-platform list; on 23 August 2026 it opened commercial tape-out and released production-grade process data (LPSIN400 SiN PDK) — the first public domestic SiPh PDK of its kind.
:::

**Chinese name:** 陕西光电子先导院科技有限公司 (Shǎnxī Guāngdiànzǐ Xiāndǎoyuàn Kējì Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

## What does this facility make?

Silicon-photonic chips (AI interconnect, LiDAR, optical computing) and GaAs VCSEL optoelectronics on pilot/MPW services; 6-inch compound line online since 2023 with 20+ PDKs and 80+ customers.

## Why does it matter?

Core of Shaanxi's 'Chasing Light' photonics program (409 firms, ¥41 billion output in 2025) — and an operator claim worth tracking: SiPh tape-out cycles '5x faster than overseas', because the alternative for Chinese designers was queuing at foreign pilot fabs.

## Project Timeline

- **Jan 2015** — Founded by CAS Xi'an Institute of Optics + provincial/high-tech-zone government
- **Mar 2023** — 6-inch compound-semiconductor platform opens
- **Nov 2025** — 8-inch silicon-photonics pilot line activated — first in northwest China
- **Aug 2026** — First public release of production-grade SiPh PDK; full commercial tape-out opens
